notes.title: New Update in the works
notes.content: New update in the works. It will add add a little more content and new functionality. We are currently testing a system where you can switch between top-down (as it is now) and third-person. View how it looks here: [url=https://youtu.be/Cr9846st1cY]Youtube link[/url]

tags.feature: We are currently testing a system where you can switch between top-down (as it is now) and third-person.

notes.title: Bug Fix update
notes.content: We have released a bug fix update for the game, there will probably be another bugfix-update. But after that, Episode 3 with 10 new stages are coming to move the story forward.

tags.feature: Episode 3 with 10 new stages are coming to move the story forward.

notes.title: Demo Update and Coming Early Access
notes.content: We have updated the demo with bug fixes, inventory functionality and updated versions of the music tracks. We are going to release an Early Access version soon, where we will release the game in chunks until the full game is out. This is so that it can be tested by the public in an early stage.
